property_summary: For any actor that has deposited funds, a withdrawBalance call always succeeds (the reentrancy lock is released after each completed guarded call), but the mutant permanently latches the lock so a later withdrawBalance reverts.
change_summary: Delete the statement `locked_ = false;` so the lock is never released after the first guarded call, causing all later addToBalance/withdrawBalance calls to revert and leaving userBalance unchanged.
